name: Arduino Uno
description: Standard ATmega328P based microcontroller board with 14 digital I/O pins and 6 analog inputs.
safety_notes: Input voltage limit 7-12V via barrel jack. GPIO max 40mA per pin, total 200mA limit.

name: ESP32
description: Dual-core 32-bit SoC with integrated Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n and Bluetooth 4.2/BLE.
safety_notes: Logic is strictly 3.3V. Applying 5V directly to GPIO pins will permanently destroy the chip.

name: Raspberry Pi
description: Quad-core Cortex-A72 64-bit SoC single board computer running Linux.
safety_notes: GPIO pins operate at strictly 3.3V with 16mA max per pin. Requires stable 5V 3A USB-C PSU.

name: LDR
description: Light Dependent Resistor whose resistance decreases with increasing incident light intensity.
safety_notes: Must be wired in voltage divider circuit with 10k resistor to read analog voltage.

name: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor
description: Non-contact ultrasonic distance measuring module detecting range between 2cm to 400cm.
safety_notes: Echo pin outputs 5V. When connecting to 3.3V microcontrollers (ESP32/RPi), a voltage divider is mandatory.

name: PIR Sensor
description: HC-SR501 passive infrared sensor module used for detecting human or animal motion.
safety_notes: Needs 30-60 seconds settling time after boot. Output pin is 3.3V compatible.

name: Temperature Sensor
description: DHT11 digital temperature and humidity sensor module with calibrated digital output.
safety_notes: Requires a 4.7k - 10k pull-up resistor between VCC and Data pin if not on a breakout board.

name: Gas Sensor
description: MQ-2 flammable gas and smoke detector suitable for LPG, i-butane, propane, and methane.
safety_notes: Internal heating element gets warm during normal operation (heats up to ~150mA). Provide adequate power.

name: Soil Moisture Sensor
description: Resistive or capacitive soil moisture probe used to detect volumetric water content in soil.
safety_notes: Resistive probes are prone to corrosion over time if kept constantly energized. Pulse VCC before measurement.

name: LED
description: Standard 5mm through-hole Light Emitting Diode (assorted red, green, blue).
safety_notes: NEVER connect directly across power or MCU pin without a current-limiting resistor (e.g. 220Ω to 330Ω).

name: RGB LED
description: Common cathode 4-pin RGB LED capable of full RGB color mixing via PWM.
safety_notes: Must use separate current-limiting resistors for each Red, Green, and Blue anode.

name: Buzzer
description: Active/passive 5V piezoelectric audio transducer for acoustic alerts and tones.
safety_notes: Observe polarity markings (+/-). For inductive passive buzzers, use flyback diode or driver transistor.

name: DC Motor
description: Small DC toy/hobby motor for vehicle chassis, fans, and simple mechanical rotation.
safety_notes: Do not drive directly from microcontroller pins. High stall current and back-EMF will destroy MCU. Use H-bridge driver.

name: Servo Motor
description: Micro SG90 9g 180-degree analog positional servo motor with gears.
safety_notes: Current spikes during sudden moves can cause microcontroller brownout. Connect to dedicated external 5V supply.

name: Relay
description: 1-channel 5V relay module with optocoupler isolation to switch high-voltage/mains loads.
safety_notes: Extreme caution required when switching mains AC (110-240V). Ensure proper terminal insulation and enclosure.

name: OLED
description: 0.96 inch I2C 128x64 OLED display module with SSD1306 controller.
safety_notes: Verify I2C pullup resistors on SDA/SCL lines. Typical default address is 0x3C.

name: LCD
description: 16x2 character alphanumeric LCD display module with I2C backpack interface.
safety_notes: Requires 5V for crisp contrast. Contrast potentiometer on backpack must be adjusted if characters do not appear.

name: Bluetooth
description: HC-05 serial Bluetooth SPP (Serial Port Protocol) module for transparent wireless serial connection.
safety_notes: RX pin is 3.3V logic only. Connecting a 5V TX pin from Arduino directly to HC-05 RX will degrade or burn the module.

name: Wi-Fi
description: ESP8266 ESP-01 Wi-Fi serial transceiver module with TCP/IP protocol stack.
safety_notes: Needs high peak current (300mA+) at 3.3V during RF transmission. Arduino 3.3V regulator pin cannot supply this safely.

name: GSM
description: SIM800L quad-band GSM/GPRS cellular module for SMS, voice calls, and GPRS data transmission.
safety_notes: Requires 3.7V - 4.2V with massive 2A burst current capability (Li-Ion battery or LM2596 buck). Will reboot if current is insufficient.

name: NRF
description: NRF24L01+ 2.4GHz ISM band RF wireless transceiver module with SPI interface.
safety_notes: VCC must strictly be 3.3V (do not supply 5V). Add a 10uF capacitor across VCC and GND pins for stable operation.

name: Resistor
description: Assorted metal film resistors (220Ω, 330Ω, 1kΩ, 4.7kΩ, 10kΩ).
safety_notes: Check rated power dissipation (typically 0.25W). High current causes resistor to overheat.

name: Capacitor
description: Assorted electrolytic (10uF, 100uF, 470uF) and ceramic (100nF) capacitors for filtering and decoupling.
safety_notes: Observe polarity on electrolytic capacitors! Reverse connection will lead to explosion or damage.

name: Transistor
description: BC547 NPN general-purpose bipolar junction transistor for switching and amplification.
safety_notes: Always include a base resistor (e.g. 1kΩ) to limit base-emitter junction current.

name: Diode
description: 1N4007 standard silicon rectifier diode used for reverse polarity protection and inductive kickback flyback.
safety_notes: Has forward voltage drop of approx 0.7V. Note cathode ring mark for correct orientation.

name: Voltage Regulator
description: L7805 linear positive 5V voltage regulator in TO-220 package.
safety_notes: Dissipates excess voltage as heat (P = (Vin - Vout) * I). Use a heatsink if input voltage exceeds 9V under moderate load.

name: Jumper Wires
description: Multi-colored 20cm breadboard jumper wires (Male-to-Male, Male-to-Female, Female-to-Female).
safety_notes: High contact resistance may occur with loose pins. Not suitable for carrying currents >1.5A.

name: Breadboard
description: Full-size 830-point solderless breadboard with dual power distribution buses.
safety_notes: Power rails are often split in the middle on 830-point boards. Bridge the split if continuous power rail is needed.

name: Battery
description: Standard 9V alkaline / zinc-carbon PP3 battery with snap connector clip.
safety_notes: 9V PP3 batteries have very high internal resistance and cannot support high current loads such as servo motors or GSM modules.
